governing_law: UPDATE preserves identity; AMENDMENT preserves identity and prior authority while changing a bounded graph region; EVOLUTION creates an explicit successor carrier/topology.

casepath_trust_centre.identity_rule: preserve CasePath service identity and prior graph-node authority
casepath_trust_centre.observer_rule: public readback is consumed after/during actuation and does not create execution permission

casepath_addressability.lineage_rule: predecessor remains immutable authority; successor owns future topology

ring2_future_memory.rule: absence is addressable state; binding later must not rewrite the fact that backing was previously unresolved

observer_memory.rule: observer state alters reconciliation, routing, repair and continuation without becoming an ontological execution gate
